query: I have a 73-year-old man admitted from a SNF with principal UTI. Among male Medicare patients 68–78 admitted from SNF with principal UTI, what is the 30‑day readmission rate, median index LOS for readmitted vs non‑readmitted, and percent of stays >6 days?
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM readmissions) THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(a.hadm_id), 0) AS readmission_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN a.hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM readmissions) THEN a.los ELSE 0 END) AS avg_los_for_readmitted, AVG(CASE WHEN a.hadm_id NOT IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM readmissions) THEN a.los ELSE 0 END) AS avg_los_for_non_readmitted, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.los > 6 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(a.hadm_id), 0) AS proportion_of_stays_over_6_days FROM admissions a;
